data.content: # USMNT roster for November 2026: Predicted squad for two CONCACAF Nations League matches vs. The United States men will make their first foray into competitive football since the end of the 2026 FIFA World Cup as they meet Haiti for a pair of matches in the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals this November. The aggregate winner of this two-legged quarterfinal will advance to the semifinals, additionally earning qualification in the 2027 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The Sporting News brings you a look at how the USMNT roster for the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal might look once it has been officially unveiled. ## USMNT roster for November 2026 matches vs. Pochettino is expected to call around 26 players for the pair of CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal matches against Haiti in November.
